name: 2gether
rootCause: Spanish cryptocurrency exchange 2gether has been maliciously hacked, affecting around 5,500 users who trade on the platform. According to a statement by Spanish police dated 22 February 2022, a team from the Ministry of Cybercrime has arrested five persons suspected of hacking. A 2gether employee was reportedly found guilty of stealing $7 million from the company. He downloaded a pirated movie that contained malware. The malware hacked into the exchange’s systems, allowing hackers to steal more than $7 million in BTC and ETH. Police found attackers using computer viruses such as Remote Access Trojans (RATs) to gain access to 2gether's internal network.…

descriptions.text: Spanish cryptocurrency exchange 2gether has been maliciously hacked, affecting around 5,500 users who trade on the platform. According to a statement by Spanish police dated 22 February 2022, a team from the Ministry of Cybercrime has arrested five persons suspected of hacking. A 2gether employee was reportedly found guilty of stealing $7 million from the company. He downloaded a pirated movie that contained malware. The malware hacked into the exchange’s systems, allowing hackers to steal more than $7 million in BTC and ETH. Police found attackers using computer viruses such as Remote Access Trojans (RATs) to gain access to 2gether's internal network.…

2gether reported the theft of 114 BTC and 281 ETH from investment accounts on July 31, 2020, together with password exposure. A later EUR 1.5 million funding round supported reported BTC/ETH compensation for 91% of affected users; the largest balances faced separate arrangements as the cost of replacing the coins rose. Attackers gained access sufficient to remove assets from 2gether's investment-account environment. The company reported a server breach and password exposure but did not disclose the initial-access technique, credential permissions or withdrawal-signing path.
